# TherapyDesk — Spec
*(Working name; rename at any time.)*

---

## 1. One-liner
A booking, payment and session-notes tool for a solo licensed therapist — clients book and pay online, the therapist runs everything else.

---

## 2. Users & Roles

| Role | What they can do | What they must NEVER be able to do |
|---|---|---|
| **Therapist** (single account; the practitioner) | Set availability; view all bookings; read all intake forms; write, edit and read session notes; view payment history; cancel any appointment; configure session price | Read another therapist's data (there is only one, so N/A); share or expose session notes to any client |
| **Client** (registered user) | Create an account; complete their own intake form; book an available slot; pay for a session; view their own upcoming and past appointments; cancel with ≥ 24 hours' notice | Read session notes (theirs or anyone else's); see other clients' names, bookings or intake forms; book a slot the therapist has not offered |

---

## 3. The Core Loop

1. Client creates an account (name, email, mobile number, password).
2. Client is immediately required to complete the intake form (medical history, medications, emergency contact, etc.).
3. Client browses available slots and selects one.
4. Client pays the session fee; the slot is confirmed only after payment succeeds.
5. Both client and therapist receive an SMS confirmation.
6. An SMS reminder is sent to the client 24 hours before the session.
7. Client attends the session.
8. Therapist writes private session notes tied to that appointment.

---

## 4. Features — V1 (must ship)

**1. Client Accounts**
*As a client, I want to create and log in to an account so that my bookings and intake form are saved and secure.*
- [ ] Sign-up requires: first name, last name, email, mobile phone number, password (minimum 8 characters).
- [ ] Duplicate email shows: "An account with that email already exists."
- [ ] Password is stored as a hash (scrambled using a one-way function — it cannot be read back, even by the app).
- [ ] Wrong login credentials show: "Email or password incorrect."
- [ ] Client can update their own name and phone number from their profile screen.
- [ ] A client cannot access any screen belonging to another client.

---

**2. Therapist Availability**
*As the therapist, I want to define which time slots are open so that clients can only book times I'm actually free.*
- [ ] Therapist can add a slot by entering date, start time and duration in minutes.
- [ ] Therapist can delete a future slot that has no booking attached.
- [ ] Attempting to delete a booked slot shows a warning and requires confirmation before proceeding.
- [ ] Client booking view lists slots in chronological order.
- [ ] Past slots never appear in the client booking view.
- [ ] Empty state (no slots set yet): client booking screen shows "No appointments are available right now. Check back soon."

---

**3. Booking**
*As a client, I want to pick an available slot and confirm my appointment so that my time is reserved.*
- [ ] Client sees only slots the therapist has marked as available.
- [ ] Selecting a slot shows a confirmation screen with date, time, duration and price before payment.
- [ ] If two clients attempt to book the same slot simultaneously, only one succeeds; the other sees: "That slot was just taken. Please choose another time." No charge is made to the second client.
- [ ] A booking is only created after payment succeeds (see Feature 4).
- [ ] Confirmed booking appears in both the client's "My Appointments" list and the therapist's dashboard.

---

**4. Payment**
*As a client, I want to pay for my session at the time of booking so that my slot is secured.*
- [ ] The therapist sets a single session price in Therapist Settings; that price is shown to the client before they pay.
- [ ] The slot is not held or reserved until payment succeeds.
- [ ] On payment success: booking is confirmed; SMS confirmation is sent to the client.
- [ ] On payment failure: booking is not created; client sees: "Payment failed. Please try a different card." Slot remains available.
- [ ] Client can view a receipt (amount, date, session date/time) from the appointment detail screen.
- [ ] Therapist can view payment status (paid / refunded / failed) on every appointment record.

---

**5. Intake Form**
*As a client, I want to fill in my background information so that my therapist has what she needs before our first session.*
- [ ] Fields: full legal name, date of birth, emergency contact (name + phone), presenting concerns (free text), medical history (free text), current medications (free text).
- [ ] After account creation the client is taken directly to the intake form and cannot navigate to booking until it is saved.
- [ ] Client can edit their own intake form at any time from their profile.
- [ ] Therapist can read any client's intake form from the client profile view; therapist cannot edit it.
- [ ] Free-text fields are capped at 2,000 characters each; a character counter and "Maximum length reached" appear when the cap is hit.
- [ ] If a client has no intake form on file, the therapist's client profile shows: "Intake form not yet submitted."

---

**6. Session Notes**
*As the therapist, I want to write private notes for each session so that I can track client progress over time.*
- [ ] Each confirmed appointment has a notes field, visible only to the therapist.
- [ ] Therapist can create, edit and save notes on any appointment record.
- [ ] Notes auto-save as a draft every 30 seconds while the therapist is typing.
- [ ] Notes are never shown to the client in any view, notification or export.
- [ ] Notes accept plain text up to 10,000 characters; beyond that, the field shows "Maximum length reached."
- [ ] Appointment with no note yet shows: "No notes yet. Tap to start writing."

---

**7. SMS Reminders & Cancellation**
*As a client, I want a reminder before my session and a clear cancellation policy so that I don't forget and know the rules upfront.*
- [ ] SMS confirmation is sent to the client immediately after a booking is confirmed.
- [ ] SMS reminder is sent to the client 24 hours before session start time.
- [ ] Client can cancel from "My Appointments" if the session is more than 24 hours away; cancellation triggers a full refund and the slot reopens.
- [ ] If the client attempts to cancel within 24 hours, the action is blocked and the screen shows: "Cancellations within 24 hours are not refundable. Your session fee has already been charged."
- [ ] Therapist can cancel any appointment at any time; doing so triggers a full refund and sends the client an SMS: "Your session on [date] has been cancelled by your therapist."
- [ ] If an SMS fails to deliver, the failure is logged and a warning badge appears on the appointment record in the therapist's view.

---

## 5. Features — Later (explicitly NOT in V1)

- **Recurring / package bookings** — multi-session billing adds significant payment complexity.
- **In-app messaging** — a separate communication surface; not core to the loop.
- **Video / telehealth sessions** — requires streaming infrastructure; a separate product.
- **Client-visible session summaries or homework** — requires a new therapist workflow.
- **Waitlist** — queue management is not needed to prove the loop.
- **Multiple therapists / group practice** — out of scope for a solo-practitioner tool.
- **Calendar sync** (Google Calendar, iCal) — useful quality-of-life feature; not core.
- **Insurance billing / superbills** — complex compliance work; a separate project.
- **Therapist earnings dashboard / payout management** — depends on payment-provider setup decisions made in a later stage.

# TherapyDesk — Spec

## 1. One-liner
A private booking and session-notes tool for one solo licensed therapist: clients book and pay online per session, and the therapist keeps clinical notes they alone can ever read.

---

## 2. Users & Roles

| Role | What they can do | What they must NEVER be able to do |
|---|---|---|
| **Therapist** (there is exactly one) | View and manage all appointments; write and edit session notes for any client; view all intake forms; set availability and the session fee; issue refunds | Expose any data to a second therapist account; view another practice's data |
| **Client** | Register and log in; complete their own intake form; browse available slots; book and pay; cancel upcoming appointments; view their own upcoming and past appointments; edit their own intake form | Read session notes (their own or anyone else's); see another client's data; change the session fee |

---

## 3. The Core Loop

1. Client creates an account and verifies their email address.
2. On first login, client completes the intake form (medical history, medications, reason for therapy, emergency contact, consent). They cannot book until this is done.
3. Client browses the therapist's available time slots on a calendar and selects one.
4. Client pays the session fee on the checkout screen. The slot is confirmed only after payment succeeds.
5. Client receives an SMS reminder 24 hours before and again 1 hour before the session.
6. Session takes place.
7. Therapist opens the appointment on their dashboard and writes session notes.

---

## 4. Features — V1 (must ship)

**1. Client Accounts**
*As a client, I want to register and log in so that my bookings and intake form are saved to me.*
- [ ] Registration requires full name, email, and password (minimum 8 characters).
- [ ] Email verification is required before the client can book; attempting to skip it shows "Please verify your email first."
- [ ] Login fails with "Incorrect email or password" if credentials are wrong (no hint about which field is wrong).
- [ ] "Forgot password" sends a reset link; the link expires after 1 hour.
- [ ] The therapist logs in via a separate `/therapist/login` path using their own credentials.
- [ ] A client who navigates to any therapist-only URL sees "Access denied" and no therapist data.

---

**2. Intake Form**
*As a therapist, I want every client to complete a medical intake form before their first session so that I have the clinical context I need.*
- [ ] The form is shown immediately after a client's first login; booking is blocked until the form is submitted with the consent checkbox ticked.
- [ ] Form fields: emergency contact name (text), emergency contact phone (text), current medications (free text), relevant medical history (free text), reason for seeking therapy (free text), consent checkbox.
- [ ] All fields except medications are required; medications may be left blank.
- [ ] After submission, the client can edit their form from their profile page; each save overwrites the previous entry.
- [ ] The therapist can view any client's intake form from that client's detail page.
- [ ] The form does not appear anywhere in the client-facing UI in the therapist's formatted view — the client only sees their own edit form.

---

**3. Appointment Booking**
*As a client, I want to see available slots and book one so that I can schedule a session.*
- [ ] Calendar displays only slots the therapist has marked as available.
- [ ] A slot already held by another client does not appear on the calendar.
- [ ] Selecting a slot shows a summary (date, time, session fee) before the client proceeds to payment.
- [ ] Booking is confirmed only after payment succeeds (see Feature 4).
- [ ] If the slot is taken between selection and payment, the client sees "Sorry, that slot was just taken — please choose another time" and is returned to the calendar; they are not charged.
- [ ] The therapist can add, edit, and remove available slots from the Schedule Management screen.
- [ ] The system blocks double-booking at the server level (not just in the interface — meaning even a direct technical request cannot create two bookings for the same slot).

---

**4. Per-Session Payment**
*As a client, I want to pay when I book so that my appointment is secured.*
- [ ] Checkout screen shows the session fee and the appointment date/time before the client enters card details.
- [ ] If payment fails, the slot is not booked and the message reads: "Payment failed — your card was not charged. Please try again or use a different card."
- [ ] A receipt is emailed to the client after successful payment.
- [ ] Each appointment in the therapist's view shows its payment status (Paid / Refunded).
- [ ] The therapist can issue a full refund for any paid appointment from the Appointment Detail screen; the status updates to Refunded immediately.

---

**5. Cancellation Policy**
*As a therapist, I want clients who cancel within 24 hours to forfeit their payment so that my time is protected.*
- [ ] Client can cancel any upcoming appointment from the My Appointments screen.
- [ ] If cancelled more than 24 hours before the start time: a full refund is issued and the client receives a confirmation SMS.
- [ ] If cancelled within 24 hours of the start time: no refund is issued; the client sees "Cancellations within 24 hours are non-refundable per our policy."
- [ ] The therapist sees, on the Appointment Detail screen, whether the cancellation was within 24 hours and whether a refund was issued.
- [ ] A cancelled slot is immediately returned to the available pool for other clients to book.
- [ ] The therapist can still manually issue a refund from Appointment Detail even for a within-24-hour cancellation (therapist discretion).

---

**6. SMS Reminders**
*As a client, I want SMS reminders before my appointment so that I don't forget to attend.*
- [ ] A mobile phone number is required before the client's first booking; the profile page prompts for it if missing.
- [ ] An SMS is sent to the client 24 hours before the appointment start time.
- [ ] A second SMS is sent to the client 1 hour before the appointment start time.
- [ ] The therapist also receives an SMS 1 hour before each appointment showing the client's name and time.
- [ ] If the appointment is cancelled, any pending reminders are suppressed.
- [ ] If an SMS fails to deliver, the booking remains confirmed; the therapist's dashboard shows a warning icon on that appointment ("Reminder SMS not delivered").

---

**7. Session Notes**
*As a therapist, I want to write private session notes linked to each appointment so that I can track each client's progress.*
- [ ] A "Write notes" button appears on each appointment card on the therapist dashboard.
- [ ] Notes are a free-text area; the server accepts up to 50,000 characters. A soft warning appears at 45,000; submission above 50,000 is blocked with "Entry is too long — please shorten it."
- [ ] Saving a note records the timestamp and links the note to the specific appointment and client.
- [ ] The therapist can edit a note at any time; saving overwrites the previous content.
- [ ] Session notes do not appear anywhere in the client-facing interface. A direct URL attempt returns "Access denied" with no note content in the response — not even in error messages.
- [ ] The therapist can search clients by name from the Client List screen to find their notes quickly.

---

## 5. Features — Later (explicitly NOT in V1)

- **Recurring appointments** — adds cancellation-policy edge cases across a booking series.
- **Package / block payments** — contradicts the per-session model confirmed for V1.
- **Client–therapist messaging** — large security surface; not needed to prove the core loop.
- **Note version history / audit log** — useful for compliance but not required for launch.
- **Superbills / insurance invoices** — PDF receipts formatted for insurance reimbursement.
- **Telehealth / video integration** — out of scope until booking and notes are proven.
- **Multiple therapists** — V1 is a single-therapist system by design.
- **Third-party calendar sync** (Google Calendar, iCal).
- **SOAP note templates** or other structured note formats.

## 8. Edge Cases & Empty States

1. **No appointments yet (client):** My Appointments shows "You haven't booked any sessions yet" with a "Book your first session" button.
2. **No appointments today (therapist):** Dashboard shows "No sessions today." Schedule Management shows an empty calendar with "Add available times to open booking for clients."
3. **Returning client without a completed intake form** (e.g. session expired mid-form): on next login, redirected to the intake form before the calendar.
4. **Duplicate payment submit** (client taps Pay twice or re-submits): the second request is rejected at the server; the client lands on their existing booking confirmation — no double charge.
5. **Slot taken between selection and payment:** payment is blocked, the client sees "Sorry, that slot was just taken — please choose another time" and is returned to the calendar with no charge.
6. **Payment fails:** slot is not booked, a clear error message is shown (see Feature 4), and the calendar stays open to retry or pick a different slot.
7. **Late cancellation (within 24 hours):** no refund issued; client sees the non-refundable message; appointment is marked "Cancelled — no refund" in Appointment Detail.
8. **Client attempts to access session notes directly** (e.g. by guessing a URL or making a direct API call — a request sent to the server outside the normal screens): the server returns HTTP 403 ("you don't have permission") with no note content in the response, not even in the error message.
9. **Very long free text:** character count is shown in real time in the intake form and session note editor; soft warning at 45,000 characters; hard block at 50,000 with "Entry is too long — please shorten it."
10. **SMS delivery failure:** booking confirmed regardless; therapist dashboard shows a warning icon on the appointment — "Reminder SMS not delivered."
11. **First-time therapist login (no availability set):** redirected to Schedule Management first with the message "Add your available times to open booking for clients."
12. **Therapist issues a refund for a within-24h cancellation** (therapist's discretion): refund button remains available; status updates to Refunded.

---

## 9. Out of Scope

- Multiple therapists or practice-wide management
- Insurance billing, superbills, or EOB documents
- Telehealth / video session integration
- In-app messaging between therapist and client
- Group therapy sessions
- Native mobile apps (iOS / Android) — V1 is web-only
- Waitlist management
- SOAP note templates or structured clinical note formats
- Automatic session-completion detection
- Export or backup of notes and client records
- Third-party calendar sync (Google Calendar, Outlook, iCal)
- Note version history or audit log

---

## 10. Success =

1. **A new client books and pays in under 5 minutes** — measured from the Register screen to Booking Confirmation on a first visit, tested with 3 real users.
2. **Zero session-note content reachable by any client account** — verified by attempting direct URL access, guessed IDs, and direct API calls on a staging copy of the app before launch.
3. **The therapist writes a session note in under 2 minutes** — measured from opening the dashboard to saving the note, logged across the first 5 real appointments.

---

## Context Carry

**One-liner:** Private booking and session-notes tool for one solo licensed therapist; clients book and pay per session online.
**Roles:** Therapist (single admin — full access to all data); Client (self-service — own bookings, own intake form, no access to notes).
**Core loop:** Client registers → completes intake form → books slot → pays → receives SMS reminders → attends → therapist writes session notes.
**V1 features:** Client Accounts, Intake Form, Appointment Booking, Per-Session Payment, Cancellation Policy (24-hour rule), SMS Reminders, Session Notes.
**Data entities:** User, IntakeForm, Appointment, Payment, SessionNote, AvailableSlot.
**Sensitive data:** IntakeForm and SessionNote contain personal health information (medical history, medications, clinical notes — HIPAA-relevant); Payment contains financial transaction data. Privacy and legal review required before launch.
